children: Overview
China coal miner's H1 net income attributable rises 11.8% yr/yr to RMB 8.2 bln
Company credits improved production quality and operational efficiency for results
Net cash inflow from production and sales activities up 68.2% yr/yr
Outlook
China Coal Energy budgets total 2026 capex of RMB21.326 bln
Result Drivers
COAL PRICING – Coal gross profit rose 6.9% to RMB11.465 bln as higher selling prices lifted self-produced coal revenue by RMB3.319 bln, offsetting lower volumes
CHEMICAL MARGINS – Chemical gross profit rose 69.2% to RMB2.191 bln as sales volumes and prices increased; polyolefin unit costs fell 12.4% after prior-year plant overhauls
TRADING VOLUME DECLINE – Proprietary coal trading revenue fell as volumes dropped 14.6 mln tonnes, partly offset by RMB77/tonne higher prices
